adjudication.rationale: In `admin/templates/group_member.hbs`, the conditional `{{#unless automatic}}` is inside the per-member item view rendered via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`. The item template’s active context is the iterated `member` (a `Discourse.User`), and the diff does not show `automatic` being passed/bound into the `group-member` view. Thus `automatic` will be undefined/falsey in that context, making `{{#unless automatic}}` always true and rendering the remove link even for automatic groups. Server-side `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` explicitly blocks automatic groups with a 422, so the UI guard is broken as described.
